remediation_steps.step:
Back up the source file before making any edits.

Command:
    cp /opt/vuln-labs/serverless-lab/lambda_function.py /opt/vuln-labs/serverless-lab/lambda_function.py.bak-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)

Why: OWASP recommends maintaining the ability to rollback any security fix to the pre-fix state in case the change introduces functional regressions.

Replace the weak random token generation with a secure method using the secrets module.

Command:
  #EDIT_FILE
  {"path": "/opt/vuln-labs/serverless-lab/lambda_function.py",
   "old_text": "token = secrets.token_hex(16)",
   "new_text": "token = secrets.token_urlsafe(16)"}

Why: The secrets module provides cryptographically strong random numbers suitable for security purposes, ensuring that tokens are unpredictable.

Verify that the vulnerable pattern is no longer present in the file.

Command:
  #VERIFY_ABSENT
  {"path": "/opt/vuln-labs/serverless-lab/lambda_function.py",
   "pattern": "random"}

Why: Ensuring the absence of the vulnerable pattern confirms that the insecure token generation method has been fully removed.

Run a syntax check to ensure the code is still valid after the edit.

Command:
    python3 -m py_compile /opt/vuln-labs/serverless-lab/lambda_function.py

Why: Syntax checking ensures that the code changes did not introduce any syntax errors, maintaining the application's functionality.
